module_summary: Wishbone-to-AXI-Lite bridge that registers each accepted WB request onto AW/W or AR channels, counts outstanding transactions for stall/ack, and tracks bus errors and post-reset settling.

anchors.name: o_wb_stall
anchors.why: WB stall combining full, direction change, error, reset and AXI backpressure; gates request acceptance

anchors.name: i_wb_stb
anchors.why: WB request strobe; with !stall launches AXI read or write requests

anchors.name: o_wb_ack
anchors.why: WB acknowledge pulse raised on successful AXI B or R response

anchors.name: o_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: AXI write-address valid, set on accepted WB write, held until awready

anchors.name: o_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: AXI read-address valid, set on accepted WB read, held until arready

anchors.name: err_state
anchors.why: Error-recovery flag set on bus error or abort; stalls WB and suppresses acks until drained

anchors.name: i_wb_we
anchors.why: WB write-enable selects AXI write channels versus read channel

anchors.name: o_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: AXI write-data valid, set on accepted WB write, held until wready

anchors.name: o_axi_awaddr
anchors.why: AXI write address latched from WB word address when not stalled

anchors.name: o_axi_araddr
anchors.why: AXI read address latched from WB word address when not stalled

anchors.name: o_axi_wdata
anchors.why: AXI write data registered from WB write data

anchors.name: o_axi_wstrb
anchors.why: AXI write strobes registered from WB byte selects

anchors.name: i_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: AXI read response valid; drives WB ack/err and decrements counters

anchors.name: i_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: AXI write response valid; drives WB ack/err and decrements counters

anchors.name: o_wb_data
anchors.why: WB read data registered from AXI read data every cycle

anchors.name: i_axi_rdata
anchors.why: AXI read data payload forwarded to WB data output

anchors.name: i_wb_data
anchors.why: WB write data captured into AXI write data register

anchors.name: i_wb_addr
anchors.why: WB word address shifted into AXI byte addresses

anchors.name: o_wb_err
anchors.why: WB error response raised when AXI bresp or rresp signals error

anchors.name: outstanding
anchors.why: Counts outstanding WB requests; sets pending and full_fifo

anchors.name: pending
anchors.why: Requests outstanding flag; stalls direction changes and flags abort errors

anchors.name: full_fifo
anchors.why: Outstanding-count full flag that stalls new WB requests

anchors.name: axi_reset_state
anchors.why: Post-reset settling flag; stalls WB and clears counters until reset_count expires

anchors.name: reset_count
anchors.why: Down-counter timing the AXI reset settling period

anchors.name: wb_we
anchors.why: Direction of last accepted request; stalls on read/write switch while pending

anchors.name: err_pending
anchors.why: Counts AXI responses still due; clears err_state when zero

groups.name: WB request acceptance
groups.description: Stall logic deciding when WB requests are accepted and routed to read or write

groups.name: AXI request channels
groups.description: Registered AW, W and AR valid/payload signals held until AXI ready

groups.name: Response return
groups.description: Converts AXI B/R responses into WB ack, err and read data

groups.name: Transaction tracking
groups.description: Counters of outstanding requests and expected AXI responses

groups.name: Error and reset recovery
groups.description: Error-drain state and post-reset settling timer that stall the bridge
